segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַפַּיִיס הַשְּׁלִישִׁי: חֲדָשִׁים לִקְטֹרֶת בֹּאוּ וְהָפִיסוּ. וְהָרְבִיעִי: חֲדָשִׁים עִם יְשָׁנִים — מִי מַעֲלֶה אֵבָרִים מִן הַכֶּבֶשׁ לַמִּזְבֵּחַ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» Before «the third lottery,» the appointee declared: Let only those priests who are «new to» offering «the incense» come and «participate in the lottery» for the incense. «The fourth» lottery was open to those «new» to the service along «with» those «old» hands who had already performed it, to determine «who» would «take the limbs up from the ramp,» where they had been placed earlier, «to the altar.»

moves.summary: fourth lottery: taking limbs from the ramp to the altar

positions.claim: the incense lottery is for priests new to it; the fourth lottery is open to new and old
